versions.changelog: clawguard@1.0.2: Added --summary-only decision output for faster install reviews, improved medium-severity explanation in summaries, and added optional human review notes via --note.
clawguard@1.0.1: Improved review precision for real third-party skills by removing markdown code-fence false positives and splitting credential mentions from explicit secret exposure guidance.
clawguard@1.0.0: Initial release of a local-first OpenClaw security review skill for third-party skill vetting, structured rule matching, evidence-based reporting, and JSON-friendly output.
